comparison.objective: Candidate installs a long rail across rack posts; record lowers a bent tube into four checking-fixture slots for inspection.
comparison.physical_skill: Both require bimanual support, leveling, multi-site alignment, and release of a long rigid object. Candidate additionally requires tab depression, compliant prong insertion, preserved front retention during telescoping, and screw fastening; record requires near-simultaneous gravity seating of four tube legs.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate checks mechanical latching and prescribed fasteners; record checks four legs within slot floor/centerline limits, release, rest, and drop-speed damage.
comparison.reason: This is a meaningful skill neighbor, but the record tests simultaneous fixture seating of one shaped part, while the candidate tests staged spring-latch assembly across front and rear supports. Candidate must add numeric level, prong, drop, deformation, and overload thresholds to keep that distinction testable.
